summary: Frontend-only validation of the new CityHero weather + season chips overlay. Tested /sightseeing (Kyoto) and /planner (Barcelona) on desktop, plus mobile viewport (375x812) for Kyoto, plus /hotels smoke check. All acceptance criteria pass: chips container renders top-right, weather chip shows temperature + description, season chip shows tier label + Best months, and layout remains readable on mobile with chips staying within hero bounds. No JS/hydration errors thrown by CityHero on any page.

issues: Chips container overlaps the upper edge of the hero image; only one chip is comfortably visible above the fold within the hero due to short mobile aspect ratio. Not a failure per spec (silent-fail acceptable), but consider stacking chips more compactly or reducing font-size on <sm breakpoints.

critical_code_review_comments: CityHero.tsx line 278: `styles.replace('bg-', 'bg-').replace(/\/10/g, '/12')` is a no-op for the first replace and relies on runtime string mangling of Tailwind classes. Tailwind's JIT does not detect dynamically-composed class names — the /12 variants may not be generated in production. Prefer static class literals per tier.
CityHero.tsx: `weather` and `bestTime` useEffects share the same trigger conditions and cleanup pattern — could be extracted to a single hook `useCityHeroSignals(city)` to reduce duplication.

SeasonChip currentScore defaults to 50 (=> 'shoulder') when monthData is missing — this may render misleading info if LLM returns no month entry for the current month. Consider returning null and hiding the chip in that case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids validated: city-hero-chips, city-hero-weather, city-hero-season. Kyoto returned '29° Clear' + 'Shoulder season · BEST: NOV, OCT, APR'. Barcelona (planner) returned '30° Partly cloudy' + 'Peak season now · BEST: JUN, MAY, SEP'. Note: on /planner the fastest way to seed the city is the 'Quick examples' buttons (Kyoto/Barcelona/Bali/Da Nang); typing into the CityAutocomplete input directly via page.fill worked for value but Generate button then didn't trigger — using quick example is more reliable. /hotels loaded cleanly with no errors. The only console error observed was an unrelated CSP worker-src violation (blob worker blocked) — not caused by CityHero. Cookie consent banner overlaps the bottom of the page on all routes (expected per spec).
